authorization.text: 要把runtime对接product shell和shared data（axis）的接口都开放出来，让外部能够衔接

required_changes: Expose dynamic Operation and coarse shell subscriptions in DLL/C++ and JS, with explicit unsubscribe and non-reentrant dispatch
Expose real Operation identity, source, commit stamp and semantic generations without requiring external Semantic headers
Retain bounded outbound packets until explicit data-owner custody release; prepare encoding and capacity before local canonical mutation; reject overload without mutation
Expose per-operation local-durability/cloud-sync reports through the existing LocalOperationSink status path, without treating them as document/blob closure proof
Expose independent mixed-outcome remote batch application with packet identity checks, no local echo and no generic Transaction
Expose snapshot through-commit and a controlled close publication barrier; preserve force abandon semantics
Document external Product Shell and Axis responsibilities and provide real external consumer tests
forbidden_changes: server revision or generic canonical transaction
required_proof: Real published old DLL RED for missing data attach
Strict native SDK and external consumer with owned bytes/metadata, replay no-echo, duplicate/mixed batches, wrong/stale status, backlog admission, abort, Undo/Redo, unsubscribe and close barrier
Actual Chrome/WASM JS consumer and existing frame/input/IME synthetic regression
Existing affected Runtime/History/composition regression, explicit missing/failed test reporting
terminal_success: Working Windows and JS external bridge with exact local build/test evidence; no storage, protocol, Gate, PHYS or stable-ABI claim
terminal_blockers: existing owner cannot satisfy required contract without unresolved semantic changes
scope_clarifications: Local durable-log replay reuses the existing RestoreReplay source; remote synchronization retains RemoteSync. Neither path emits new local Operations or restores History.
